title: How Deep is the Signal? Time-Context up to 30 Years for Colorectal Cancer Prediction in a Primary-Care EHR Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.07265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EHR foundation models read medical events within a fixed context window, and long context has so far been measured only in tokens. How far back in time a model must look to capture the earliest predictive signal is unknown. We introduce time-context, the calendar lookback window before the prediction point, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of decade-scale time-context for an EHR foundation model. We pretrained a decoder-only transformer (34.6M parameters) on 1.4B coded events from 3.6M primary-care patients in North West London and fine-tuned it to predict incident colorectal cancer under a 12-month pre-diagnostic buffer. A frozen cohort of 1,008 cases and 9,582 matched controls, all registered for at least 30 years, was evaluated at 15 nested lookback windows from 2 to 30 years, so that every truncation is compared within the same patients. translated_title: 信号有多深？初级保健EHR模型中利用长达30年时间上下文的结直肠癌预测
translated_abstract: EHR基础模型在固定的上下文窗口内读取医疗事件，而迄今为止长上下文仅以token数量来衡量。模型需要回溯多远的时间才能捕捉到最早的预测信号，目前尚不清楚。我们提出了“时间上下文”（time-context）这一概念，即预测点之前的日历回溯窗口，并据我们所知，首次对EHR基础模型进行了十年尺度时间上下文的系统性评估。我们在来自伦敦西北部360万名初级保健患者的14亿条编码事件上预训练了一个仅解码器Transformer模型（3460万参数），并对其进行微调，以在12个月诊断前缓冲期的条件下预测新发结直肠癌。在一个由1,008例病例和9,582名匹配对照组成的固定队列中（所有患者均注册至少30年），我们在从2年到30年的15个嵌套回溯窗口上进行了评估，使得每次截断都在同一批患者内进行比较。判别性能从2年回溯时的AUROC 0.551提升至……
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了EHR基础模型的“时间上下文”对疾病预测的影响，发现将日历回溯窗口从2年延长至最长30年可显著提升结直肠癌的早期预测性能。
en_tdlr: This work introduces "time-context" and provides the first systematic evaluation of decade-scale calendar lookback windows (up to 30 years) for an EHR foundation model, showing that longer lookback improves colorectal cancer prediction.
